warnings: Legend (หมายเหตุ): dashed = แป เหล็ก C-75x45x15x2.3 mm. @1.00 m., thin solid = จันทัน C-100x50x20x3.2 mm. @1.50 m., dash-dot = TRUSS T1 (row B). Rafters and purlins carry no mark: element_id null with element_name_assigned (section 0.2). T1 is recorded in the S-03 files, not repeated here.

The 11 rafter lines are drawn at 1.50 m from the roof edge 1' (-1.00) to 5' (14.00) — their positions are not dimensioned, only the @1.50 spacing, so no grid lines were made for them; the area ref names the roof extent. Purlins are drawn only inside the cut-away detail, so their count is left null.

Upper roof: 1.00 overhang above A and below B, 1.00 left of 1 and right of 5 (grid master A', B', 1', 5'). Building section A-08 shows this roof sloping down from T1 (row B, ระดับหลังคา +4.32) toward row A (+3.51).
